name: Founder decision: Ratify Sŏn's conduct statement on the composition of its team, and the reach read's action
markdown_description:
P35 and P36. The statement, drafted from rules the record and prior sessions already hold: the house selects every person on four reads and on nothing about who they are; runs every stage of every hire in the language the candidate chose, by someone who holds it; records nothing about who a person is on any record about them beyond the languages they work in; reads its own reach, where its candidates come from and which stage declines whom, as patterns and never as targets, and when its reach narrows it widens its reach and moves no bar for anyone; and sets no target for the composition of its team, stated so that no one is ever read against one. The last sentence is entailed by the four reads and the person page's refusals. Once the statement exists, Session 5's source-dominance and stage-rate read acts: source dominance across a stated count of reviews (a reset parameter) changes the sheet's sourcing mix; a stage rate triggers the calibration read's existing acts; neither touches a scorecard, a decision, a candidate, or a bar, and the read infers nothing about who a candidate is and never slows a seat for a pipeline's shape. Whether the house states anything about who it hopes its team will be beyond this conduct statement stays on `86akh7r8z` (Section C). Extends `86akh7rkt` by reference. Blocks I10, rows 139 and 140. Urgent, before the first seat opens externally.

Filed by Session 11 of the Scaling People translation program. Session task `86ajgmj7c`. Reasoning lives on the S11 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc `2ky45bmy-17253`.
